docs.summary: This randomized phase II/III trial studies how well lenalidomide works and compares it to observation in treating patients with asymptomatic high-risk asymptomatic (smoldering) multiple myeloma. docs.title: Improving Pain Management and Long Term Outcomes Following High Energy Orthopedic Trauma (Pain Study)
docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to definitively resolve questions regarding the use of multimodal pharmacologic pain management for orthopedic trauma patients in the context of a multicenter, randomized clinical trial.

Also, as a significant proportion of this population develops chronic post traumatic osteoarthritis (PTOA), a sub-objective of this study is to examine the etiology and incidence of chronic pain and PTOA in this population.

docs.title: A Study to Investigate the Safety and Effectiveness of SAR448851 in Participants With Early Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary:

docs.title: A Study of Trontinemab in Cognitively Unimpaired Individuals at Risk for Progression to Symptomatic Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of trontinemab in participants with biomarker evidence of Alzheimer's Disease (AD) pathology but with no cognitive or functional impairment, who are at risk for progression to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) due to AD or dementia due to AD.

docs.title: A Study of ASP388B Given by Itself and With Standard Therapies in Participants With Solid Tumors
conditions: Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors
docs.summary:

docs.title: A Study to Test Whether Survodutide Helps People With Type 2 Diabetes Control Their Blood Sugar
docs.summary:

Depending on a person's diabetes treatment, a person will be assigned either to

* Part B: diabetes

docs.title: An Open-label Long-term Safety Study of Buntanetap in Participants With AD
docs.summary: This study will examine the long-term safety of buntanetap in participants with AD who have participated in a prior study of buntanetap in AD.

docs.title: Study to Test Effects and Safety of RO7568282 in Early Symptomatic Alzheimer's Disease
docs.summary: This study aims to compare the effects of RO7568282 versus a placebo in people in the early stages of Alzheimer's disease (AD).

CLL/SLL can be controlled with drugs, but many people develop resistance, and the treatments stop working.

To test a new drug (nemtabrutinib) in people with CLL/SLL.

People aged 18 years or older with CLL/SLL that persists despite treatment.

docs.title: A Clinical Study of Sotatercept (MK-7962) in People With Combined Postcapillary and Precapillary Pulmonary Hypertension and Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction (MK-7962-041)
docs.summary: Researchers are looking for other ways to treat people with combined postcapillary and precapillary pulmonary hypertension (CpcPH). This trial focuses on CpcPH that is related to heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). The goal of the study is to learn if participants who receive sotatercept live longer without their CpcPH-HFpEF getting worse than those who receive placebo.

docs.title: A Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Petrelintide in Participants With Overweight or Obesity and Established Cardiovascular Disease
docs.summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of petrelintide compared with placebo, in conjunction with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity, for weight management in participants living with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease (CVD).

The purpose of this study is to find out how a medicine called survodutide affects heart structure and function in people with MASLD.

docs.title: Oral VK2735 for Weight Management Phase 3 (SUNRISE 1)
docs.summary: This study is one of two planned Phase 3 studies to support the weight management indication for VK2735 Oral in obese (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) or overweight (BMI ≥ 27kg/m2) adults with at least one weight-related comorbidity without type 2 diabetes mellitus.

docs.title: Oral VK2735 for Weight Management in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Phase 3 (SUNRISE 2)
docs.summary: This study is one of two planned Phase 3 studies to support the weight management indication for VK2735 Oral in obese (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) or overweight (BMI ≥ 27 kg/m2) adults with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.

docs.title: SumMET: Study of [225Ac]Ac-FL-261 in Participants With Solid Tumors Overexpressing c-MET
docs.summary: This is a first-in-human, multicenter, open-label Phase 1/2 study designed to evaluate the safety, efficacy, and tolerability of \[225Ac\]Ac-FL-261, a targeted radioligand therapy directed at c-MET, in participants with advanced or metastatic solid tumors. Phase 1 will identify the recommended dose through dose escalation, followed by a randomized comparison of two candidate dosing regimens (dose optimization). In Phase 2, the selected dose will be tested in independent cohorts by tumor type.

docs.summary:
The purpose of this study is to learn about the safety and effectiveness of berobenatide in adult women who have both stress urinary incontinence (SUI) and obesity or overweight.

Participants will be in the study for about 63 weeks

docs.title: A Study of Tersolisib (LY4064809) and Abemaciclib With Hormone Therapies in Participants With PIK3CA-Mutated Early Breast Cancer
docs.summary:
The main purpose of this study is to compare two ways of giving the anti-cancer medicines abemaciclib and hormone therapy with tersolisib in participants with early breast cancer that has a genetic mutation (PIK3CA mutation).

For each participant, the study will last up to 56 weeks and include 12 visits.

docs.title: A Study of IPG11406 Tablets in Participants With Lupus Nephritis
docs.summary:
Lupus Nephritis (LN) is one of the most serious and common complications of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE). It is a chronic inflammatory disease triggered by abnormal autoimmunity and the deposition of immune complexes in the kidneys. Approximately 40% to 60% of SLE patients develop lupus nephritis at the onset of the disease, and the cumulative rate of kidney involvement during the course of the disease can even reach 90%.

docs.title: KC1086 in Combination With Fulvestrant for HR-Positive, HER2-Negative Advanced Breast Cancer
conditions: HR-positive, HER2-negative Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer
docs.summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetic characteristics of KC1086 in combination with fulvestrant in adults with hormone receptor-positive (HR+), human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

docs.title: A Study to Assess the Effect of Pacibekitug on Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients After a Myocardial Infarction
docs.summary: The main purpose of this study is to demonstrate the superiority of pacibekitug compared to placebo in reducing the risk of 3-point coronary major adverse cardiovascular events (3P-Coronary- MACE), defined as a composite of coronary heart disease (CHD) death, non-fatal myocardial infarction (MI), and urgent coronary revascularization, in participants after an MI, at high cardiovascular (CV) risk and receiving standard of care (SoC) secondary CV prevention therapies.

docs.title: A Study of BMS-986548 as Monotherapy and in Combination With Anti-cancer Agents in Participants With Advanced Solid Malignancies
docs.summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety, tolerability, efficacy, and drug levels of BMS-986548 as a monotherapy and in combination with anti-cancer agents in participants with advanced solid malignancies.
